ops.text: AGENTS.md § Releases still documents the pre-binrun flow — "bump plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json to the tag's version in the release commit; the verify-plugin-version job fails the release on a mismatch" — but since b650c92 (binrun shim, 2026-07-23) the release.yml `descriptor` job bumps plugin.json + plugin/bin/ccx.binrun together in a bot commit AFTER publishing, and ci.yml's descriptor-agreement gate fails any manual manifest-only bump (manifest=0.33.0 vs pinned=0.32.0, run 30078578897). Following the docs cost a red CI cycle + a revert commit. AGENTS.md is guides-rendered, so the fix belongs in the source fragments.
